payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each point, check if two other points exist at distances of consecutive powers of two using precomputed list; if found, output triplet; else pair or single.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all points and all power-of-two distances, using set membership for O(1) lookups. Although no bitwise operations are used, it systematically enumerates candidate subsets of size up to 3, closest to bitmask enumeration among offered subtypes.
